notes.title: TPS control & reticle addition update Ver 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[Function addition]
- Added TPS style control. Switching from normal control is possible from the settings.
* Reticle will be displayed during operation in TPS style.


[Improvement]
- Improved viewpoint movement.

notes.title: Bug Fix Ver 1.0.5
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.

-After pressing the end button on the rescue mode result screen and returning to the title screen, and starting the rescue mode again, the fifth day, which should not exist in a desperate state that can not attack eggs, starts.

-When your ranking is 5th, the ranking is not displayed correctly.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.4
notes.notes: Made it possible to see which game mode leaderboard is displayed.

notes.title: Bug Fix Ver 1.0.2 ＆ Ver 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.2
- Fixed a bug that the order of ranking in escape mode was displayed in reverse.

Version 1.0.3
- Fixed the problem that the ranking could not be displayed even if the ranking button was pressed again after displaying the ranking from the title screen.

notes.title: Bug Fix Ver 1.0.1
notes.notes:
The following bug has been fixed.

* In rescue mode, the number of chicks rescued when retrying is incorrect

[important]
Following the bug fix, the rescue mode ranking will be reset.
Please, Rescue the chick again. We sincerely apologize.
